claims.claim: GitSources.review binds the unique safe metadata filename to its parsed REVIEW ID independently of the RUN suffix, preserving exact canonical identities.
Publication projection supports independently named reviews with proven inclusion and stable canonical refs; ingress reuses the same reader without workflow or publication mutation.

Review proof enforces the exact parent, single added regular metadata blob, path/ID agreement and fresh refs. Local Git regressions cover malformed metadata, substitutions, conflicting terminals, missing proof and drift.
The committed implementation changes exactly the two authorized paths relative to the admitted canonical base, preserving historical artifacts, workflows, authority boundaries and selector schemas.
